youtube.title: He Survived a Hole in His Stomach
youtube.description:
1822, Mackinac Island. A musket went off by accident less than a meter from Alexis St. Martin, an 18-year-old canoeman. For 17 days, everything he swallowed came back out through the wound. He should have died. He lived 58 more years, with an opening into his stomach that never closed.

The full story, from the accident to the last letter: "The Man With a Window Into His Stomach" (linked above).
